title: PRD Amendment Payload
description: Lightweight amendment payload for PRD v(N+1) authoring during Phase 5 reconciliation pass. Targets specific PRD sections (no full rewrite); triggers `validate-prd --sections=<list>` scoped re-validation. Bumps PRD VC; updates prd.meta.json with amendment_source.

source_design_deltas.description: design_delta IDs that this amendment resolves. All must have user_decision == accept_into_prd.

target_sections.description: PRD section paths to edit. e.g., ['User Stories §US-7', 'NFR §a11y'].

content.description: New content (add/modify) or removed content reference (remove).

validation_scope.description: Sections to re-validate via `validate-prd --sections=<list>`. Typically equals target_sections; may include cascading sections.

vc_bump_target.description: Target version. Minor bump for accumulated amendments under threshold; major for first amendment OR when threshold crossed.

applied_at.description: When PRD edits committed and VC bumped.
